/**
 * Header line one
 * line two
 */
import { x } from './y.js';
/** Doc for f.
 *  more doc */
export function f(a: number): string {
  // inline note
  const s = 'a // not comment';
  const t = `${a} // mid ${a} tail // end`;
  const r = /a\/\/b/u;
  /* block
     comment */
  return s + t + String(r) + x;
}
